Your share of the pond.

Each living frog holds an equal share of HFROG and unswapped IMD in the vault, including pending fees.

Only minted, unburned frogs count. Unminted frogs have no share. Burning never frees a lifetime mint slot.

05 / Shared by the frogs

The pond vault.

25% of hook fees collect here. Anyone can trigger a protected buyback; the bought HFROG stays in the vault.

HFROG in vault—

Living frogs—
Frogs burned—

Trigger a buyback

Loading cooldown…

Up to 100 IMD per buyback. At least 60 seconds between successful calls. Requires 30 minutes of price history and a 95% average-price output floor. You pay gas; funds come from the vault.

Built into the contracts.

Buybacks use the same pool and fees as trades. The site requests 0.5% quote slippage; the contract also enforces its own average-price protection.
